notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello,

Just a quick update to fix a couple of bugs reported in the latest build that would affect some players, plus some minor changes

- fixed an issue with enemy cities not showing tutorial sometimes
- fixed an issue with main menu sometimes showing when starting a new campaign
- added Esc key shortcut for closing main menu windows
- rearranged building order to match resource bar order

Our apologies to those who experienced these bugs

We're still trying to track down a reported bug where cities don't load in battle, causing automatic loss - if you encounter this bug or any other bugs, please let us know with as much detail as you can provide so we can fix them

Thank you for playing

notes.title: Tutorial and Improvements
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have a new major update that adds tutorial, improves a lot of things and brings the Prologue closer to what the full game will be

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485104/b021e9a9422555307b68d1c4622b648e2bfc1534.png[/img]

The update has a lot of player suggested improvements and fixes, including:
- a new playable tutorial that teaches the world map basics
- an option to include some of the tutorial instructions in new campaigns
- more information in the UI and new windows for managing units and buildings
- a new main menu, separating things out so it's easier to read
- new load campaign screen that provides more information about the saved campaigns
- a new feature where armies too far away when tasked on a city or army will move to the location and then initiate the action, e.g. Attack or Unit Transfer, instead of having to be re-tasked when they arrive

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485104/de380e1d602673be84fbd15f710ce612d97a4218.png[/img]

We hope you all enjoy the changes included in this update and we welcome player feedback and suggestions

notes.title: Performance and Healing
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've got another update for you

This time improving performance, reducing GPU utilization and overall making the game run smoother

We've also made a minor change to healing units in armies, in that the army no longer needs to be near a town to get the option to heal when you click on the unit in the army on the world map

notes.title: Selection Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Just a small update to fix some issues with looting and razing cities and to make selecting units and armies easier

- Fix for issues with looting and razing cities
- Armies are easier to select on the world map
- Units are easier to select in battle

notes.title: Fix for missing city
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Just a another quick update to fix a missing city

There was a small error in the ciy generation code that meant Assema on the eastern island that starts in the Kingdom of Oleria didn't load correctly in battle

Apologies for any issues you had with this

notes.title: A Quick Fix
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Just adding a quick fix for the World is Mine achievement as someone reported it wasn't working for them even though they had captured all cities

If anyone else is having issues with the game, please let me know as I'm working on more updates

notes.title: Quick Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've released an update for the Prologue, fixing an important glitch that would sometimes end the campaign early

We're also working on other fixes and improvements based on player feedback and we've included some even though they are a bit work-in-progress as we thought it important to get the glitch fix out as soon as possible

Fixes include:
- Fix for issue where campaign ended early
- Removed wall bonus from town (as countered by attackers siege equipment)
- AI army more random in targeting cities
- Increase AI chance to capture cities rather than raze or loot
- New Upgrade Building window showing cost (WIP)
- Showing looted/razed on city info

Apologies to those who have experienced the glitch

notes.title: A Wider World
notes.notes:
We've expanded the world map, adding in islands for 2 new playable kingdoms with 6 new cities, bringing it to a total of 4 kingdoms and 12 cities. Existing saved campaigns remain unchanged.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485104/5362afba0eea1878761d0bba0063746060f1f504.png[/img]

We've also made some changes to combat and information around houses/citizens, based on player feedback

Additions
- 2 new Kingdoms to play as or defeat
- 6 new Cities to rule or conquer
- 2 achievements for the new kingdoms

Combat
- units do an attack move when targeting units (will fight back against nearby units on the way)
- units do a non-attack move when targeting a location (will move to location ignoring other units, useful for retreating)
- added cursor mouseover changes to show attack and move option when units are selected

World Map
- changed citizen and housing space counter to a house icon
- citizen cost of units shown in the training window
- updated house tooltip

Performance
- changed unit LODs for better performance

notes.title: House & Balance
notes.notes:
Happy New Year! It's our first update of 2024!

We took a little break over Christmas but have also been quietly working on another update and preparing for the upcoming Steam Next Fest in February

In this update we're adding a new building (House) and doing some balancing to make battles fairer/better

Additions:
- Houses can be constructed at cities to increase the civilian population cap (used to train military units)
- Houses provide a small trickle of silver income

Balancing
- Increased Bowman range and HP
- Reduced Catapult range and damage
- Reduced Knight damage and HP

Art
- Updated Add Building and Add Unit button art

notes.title: Simplifying Changing Language
notes.notes:
Hello,

Just a small update to make it easier to switch languages - handy if you've chosen the wrong language and don't know which button is Options or which drop-box is Language

There is now a small flag in the top-left corner of the main menu - click it and you'll be prompted to select a language

notes.title: Stable Update
notes.notes:
Hello,

Small Kingdoms Prologue has been out for a month now and, while we've released a few minor updates in that time, this is the first major update adding new content

The update adds in a new building (Stables), a new unit (Knight), some Steam Deck compatibility changes, as well as some other changes, fixes and additions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485104/864a6e6b90f35083035922101976c2259e644b7c.png[/img]

[h3]Update Details[/h3]
[u][b]Main Changes[/b][/u]
New Building: Stable
New Unit: Knight
[u][b]Additional Changes[/b][/u]
Changed: Larger font by default throughout the game
Added: Option to increase or decrease the font size
Fixed: Changing resolution works a bit better now
Changed: Mouse cursor hidden during loading screens and cinematics
Changed: Mouse cursor hidden until mouse is moved (for Steam Deck compatibility)
Changed: Level of Detail (LOD) adjusted for units, props and environmental elements to improve visuals and performance

We have more updates planned as we continue to develop the Prologue and the full game

If there is anything you'd like to see added or changed, please feel free to make suggestions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485104/864a6e6b90f35083035922101976c2259e644b7c.png[/img]

If you have suggestions for other changes, fixes or additions you'd like us to make, then please let us know

notes.title: Playable on Steam Deck
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Valve have tested Small Kingdoms Prologue for Steam Deck Compatibility and have officially deemed it Playable

The only issues that stopped Small Kingdoms Prologue from getting fully Verified on Steam Deck were some fonts appearing too small and some in-game glyphs for mouse and keyboard being shown, but it is otherwise fully functional and performs well

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485104/6934488cbcbf7c8c33c641c423fd2243b3ed2560.png[/img]

We will release an update to increase the smallest font sizes and give the option for players to increase font sizes generally

This means that when the full version of Small Kingdoms releases, it too should be at least Playable on the Steam Deck

Steam Deck Compatibility is also good news for Linux users as the Steam Deck OS is Linux-based and uses Proton to run Windows games, so Linux users should be able to use Proton to run Small Kingdoms Prologue

notes.title: Small Update

If you encounter any issues with the game, let us know so we can fix them

notes.title: Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello,

The free Small Kingdoms Prologue is out now, launching in time for the Steam Strategy Fest

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485104/930132552a1d1193c7793c244bc3e070e4bb55d9.png[/img]

The prologue offers a complete campaign, playing as either of two kingdoms, with each kingdom having 3 cities to conquer.

In addition to conquering cities, you can also engage in army vs army field combat and ship vs ship naval combat with units crossing between ships on gangplanks.

The full game of Small Kingdoms has more campaigns, more kingdoms, more cities, more buildings and more units.

We hope you like Small Kingdoms Prologue and consider wishlisting Small Kingdoms

notes.title: The First Guide
notes.notes:
Hello

We've published the first guide for Small Kingdoms Prologue. It's about world map basics, covering building construction, unit training, and commanding armies.

Guide: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3027222195]World Map Basics[/url]

The guide should be enough to get new players started and similar information is shown at the start of each campaign and is accessible by selecting Help from the in-game menu when on the world map.

We will be added more guides soon, starting with Battle Basics with similar information already available in-game when you start your first battle in each campaign and is accessible by selecting Help from the in-game menu when in battle.

Let us know if there are any topics you want us to cover

We hope you have fun with the game

Small Kingdoms Prologue Devs
Bad Logic Studios
